descriptions.zh: 我们一直明目张胆地在§Y[contact_empire_system.GetName]§!星系进行行动，对于隐藏自己的行动丝毫没有任何注意。尽管他们的技术水平不高，但是即使是§Y[contact_empire.GetName]§!也注意到了我们的行动。现在第一次接触不可避免了。
descriptions.en: We have been careless, conducting operations in the §Y[contact_empire_system.GetName]§! system without bothering to hide our activities. Despite their modest technology level, even the §Y[contact_empire.GetName]§! have taken notice of our activity. First Contact is now unavoidable.

descriptions.zh:
我们围绕§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!建造了一座观测站来研究上面的居民，但却意识到§Y[contact_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!反而是在研究我们：他们完全清楚其他外星物种的存在，并很快注意到了我们[root.GetScientistPlural]的到来。

我们先前在这个恒星系的活动一定已经让[fromfrom.owner.GetName]对我们的存在有所警觉。当前情况下，保持我们的存在隐形化已经没有什么意义。
descriptions.en:
We built an observation post around §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§! to study its inhabitants, only to realize the §Y[contact_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§! are the ones studying us: they are fully aware of the existence of other alien species, and soon noticed the arrival of our [root.GetScientistPlural].

Our previous activity in this solar system must have alerted the [fromfrom.owner.GetName] to our presence. Efforts to keep our existence hidden are futile at this point.
